categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Adding a method to interfaces::Wallet to expose wallet functionality is wallet-first; the interface mechanics are not the point of the PR.
categories.rationale: The PR touches src/interfaces/wallet.h only to expose an existing wallet operation to the GUI, which IPC explicitly excludes when interface mechanics are not the focus.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and touches src/wallet/wallet.cpp, moving HD key derivation into CWallet.
categories.rationale: Exposes HD key derivation through the wallet interface to allow GUI multisig setup to derive shareable xpubs from a seed without RPC. It unblocks the GUI multisig wizard tracking issue (#35645), providing clear value for planned wallet features, though reasonably deferrable on its own.
